narratives.Description: Recut Dual stop so a parallel round records no comparable fingerprint and the sequential halt composes with #3448.
narratives.Origin: Authored from successor lean https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4442#issuecomment-5649628399 after issue:ingest refused missing-pain on Stop 1 write-back 5649572167.
narratives.Overview: > Recut 2026-09-14 to successor lean 5649628399, verified-claims 5649630157, synthesis accepted 5649632071. Bound next-build: (1) a parallel round has no early-halt path and runs to the operator-gated cap; independent critic targeting still clears the marker. (2) Parallel fingerprint working default: no comparable fingerprint exists for a parallel round, not the merged map. (3) Dual stop same-fingerprint halt composes with #3448 primary fingerprint plus material-delta; no clustering predicate. (4) Cap halt is the spend bound; drop indefinite-thrash language. (5) Sibling token isolation is purchased by Envelope and ceiling. Out of scope: clustering, parent canonicalizing sibling headings, cannot-bind chain, siblings 4267/4447/4446/4445/4444. Bound SoT: https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4442#issuecomment-5649628399
narratives.LockedDecisions: Successor lean 5649628399 is bound SoT; synthesis accepted 5649632071; verified-claims 5649630157. Marker clearance has no verdict field. Compose any remaining sequential halt with #3448; do not invent a clustering predicate.
